intentions.title: Give TypeScript consumers a single runtime-agnostic (Edge/Node/browser) SDK client that exposes the whole Barkpark API surface — docs, search, backlinks/graph, history, auth, media, schemas, webhooks, tenancy, listen, export — through one `createClient()` factory
intentions.evidence: index.ts is a curated barrel export ('Every name here becomes a permanent contract — add only symbols with documented intent'); client.ts wires ~20 operation modules (doc.ts, docs.ts, search.ts, backlinks.ts, graph.ts, history.ts, auth.ts, media.ts, schemas.ts, webhooks.ts, tenancy.ts, patch.ts, transaction.ts, publish.ts, listen.ts, export.ts) into one object literal returned by createClient().

intentions.title: Make every request fail in a typed, catchable, cross-bundle-safe way instead of leaking raw fetch/HTTP errors
intentions.evidence: errors.ts defines a BarkparkError taxonomy (Auth/Network/Timeout/RateLimit/NotFound/Validation/Hmac/SchemaMismatch/EdgeRuntime/Conflict) where every subclass carries a `code` literal equal to its class name specifically so `instanceof` (unreliable under pnpm hoist duplicates) can be replaced by `isBarkparkError(e, code)`; transport.ts's decodeErrorAndThrow maps every Phoenix status/error-code combination (401/403, 429, 412, 422, 409, 404, schema_mismatch) onto the matching class, including edge cases like a bare string `error` field or `details: null`.

intentions.title: Guarantee the SDK works unmodified in Edge/Workerd runtimes, never silently degrading
intentions.evidence: transport.ts comment: 'fetch-only (no node: built-ins, Edge-safe)'; util/edge-detect.ts + listen.ts throw BarkparkEdgeRuntimeError SYNCHRONOUSLY when SSE listen() is attempted somewhere it can't work (Workerd lacks ReadableStream readers needed for custom auth headers), rather than hanging or silently failing later.

intentions.title: Make every client-side write either safely retryable or explicitly non-retryable, and never double-apply a mutation on retry
intentions.evidence: transport.ts injects one stable uuidv7 Idempotency-Key shared across all attempts for writes opted into 'on-idempotency-key' retryPolicy so 'a lost-response-then-retry can't double-apply it'; retry.ts supplies DEFAULT_READ_POLICY/DEFAULT_WRITE_POLICY/IDEMPOTENT_WRITE_POLICY; reads default to retry-on-failure, writes default to no-retry unless opted in.

intentions.title: Reject invalid client configuration and query input eagerly, before any network call, with a specific field-level reason
intentions.evidence: client.ts's validateConfig() checks projectUrl/dataset/workspace/project/apiVersion/token/perspective/timeoutMs combinatorially (e.g. workspace+project must be set together, useCdn+drafts perspective is incompatible, timeoutMs<0 silently disabling the timeout is explicitly guarded against); filter-builder.ts's assertPaging/makeFilterExpression validate limit/offset/op/value shape before building a query string.

intentions.title: Support live, reconnecting real-time subscriptions to dataset changes over SSE without EventSource's auth limitation, resilient to half-open sockets and silent proxy loops
intentions.evidence: listen.ts implements a hand-rolled fetch+ReadableStream SSE client (EventSource can't send Authorization headers) with DEFAULT_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS (2.5x server keepalive) to detect half-open TCP sockets, MAX_SSE_BUFFER_BYTES to bound OOM from a frameless stream, MAX_CONSECUTIVE_CLEAN_CLOSES to escalate on a looping misconfigured proxy, and full-jitter exponential backoff to avoid reconnect-storm thundering herds.

intentions.title: Let generated-schema consumers (@barkpark/codegen) get compile-time-narrowed document types on doc/docs/getDocuments without any runtime behavior change
intentions.evidence: index.ts's TypedClient<TMap> + typedClient() function re-type an existing BarkparkClient's type-keyed methods against a generated TypeMap ('the runtime is the IDENTITY — only the static types narrow'), designed to pair with `barkpark generate`.

intentions.title: Detect and surface client/server drift (apiVersion or schema hash mismatch) so callers know to regenerate types or bump versions, via a cached handshake
intentions.evidence: handshake.ts's createHandshakeCache() dedupes concurrent /v1/meta calls per projectUrl+workspace+project+dataset key and exposes invalidate(); BarkparkSchemaMismatchError in errors.ts carries clientApiVersion/serverMinApiVersion/serverMaxApiVersion/localSchemaHash/remoteSchemaHash for that recovery flow (ADR-007/ADR-011).
